tools.name: eboekhouden_list_relations
tools.description: List relations (customers and suppliers of the administration), optionally filtered (filters combine with AND). Text filters match exactly unless match is contains or starts_with. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/relation.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_relation
tools.description: One relation with all its fields (addresses, e-mail addresses, VAT and KvK number, IBAN, payment term, ledger). GET /v1/relation/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_invoices
tools.description: Search the invoices created in the invoicing module, by invoice number, relation or date (exact, or from/to). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/invoice.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice with its items, amounts and relation. GET /v1/invoice/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_outstanding_invoices
tools.description: Open (unpaid) invoices: debtors (D, sales invoices customers still owe) or creditors (C, purchase invoices still to be paid). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/mutation/invoice/outstanding.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_mutations
tools.description: Search the bookkeeping mutations: type 1 invoice received, 2 invoice sent, 3 invoice payment received, 4 invoice payment sent, 5 money received, 6 money sent, 7 general journal entry. Filter by type, mutation number, description, invoice number or date. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/mut

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_mutation
tools.description: One mutation with its rows (ledger, VAT code, amount, relation, invoice number). GET /v1/mutation/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_ledgers
tools.description: The ledger accounts (grootboekrekeningen): id, code, description and category (BAL balance, VW profit and loss, FIN, DEB, CRED, AF6, AF19, AFOVERIG, VOOR, BTWRC, AF). Use the id as ledger_id in other tools. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/ledger.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_ledger
tools.description: One ledger account. GET /v1/ledger/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_ledger_balance
tools.description: The balance of one ledger, optionally per cost center and for a period (from/to). GET /v1/ledger/{id}/balance.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_ledger_balances
tools.description: The balances of all ledgers (a trial balance), optionally per cost center and for a period (from/to). GET /v1/ledger/balances.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_products
tools.description: List products and services (articles) with price, VAT code, ledger and unit, optionally by code or group code. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/product.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_product
tools.description: One product with price, VAT code, ledger, unit and stock setting. GET /v1/product/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_product_groups
tools.description: All product groups. GET /v1/product/groups.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_cost_centers
tools.description: List cost centers (kostenplaatsen), optionally by parent id or description. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/costcenter.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_cost_center
tools.description: One cost center. GET /v1/costcenter/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_units
tools.description: List product units (piece, hour, ...) with their ids. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/unit.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_invoice_templates
tools.description: List invoice templates (the template_id for eboekhouden_create_invoice), optionally by name, type (E editor, A advanced) or active. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/invoicetemplate.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_email_templates
tools.description: List e-mail templates. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/emailtemplate.

tools.name: eboekhouden_list_members
tools.description: List members; only available to clubs and associations (others get error MEM_056). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /v1/member.

tools.name: eboekhouden_get_member
tools.description: One member; only available to clubs and associations. GET /v1/member/{id}.

tools.name: eboekhouden_create_relation
tools.description: Create a new relation (customer or supplier) in the administration. Only name is required; the code is generated when omitted. Returns the new id and code. POST /v1/relation.

tools.name: eboekhouden_update_relation
tools.description: Change fields of an existing relation. The tool first reads the relation, then sends its current values with your changes on top (the API requires name on every update), so fields you do not pass keep their values. This overwrites the current values of the fields you pass. GET + PATCH /v1/relation/{

tools.name: eboekhouden_create_product
tools.description: Create a product or service. Needs code, description, a sale VAT code and a ledger id, and exactly one of price_excl or price_incl. Returns the new id. POST /v1/product.

tools.description: Create a sales invoice for a relation. PERMANENT: the API cannot change or delete invoices afterwards, and an invoice number is used up. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: eboekhouden_list_email_templates · Public sink: eboekhouden_list_email_templates, eboekhouden_create_relation, eboekhouden_create_product, eboekhouden_create_invoice · Destructive: eboekhouden_create_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: eboekhouden_list_email_templates · Public sink: eboekhouden_list_email_templates, eboekhouden_create_relation, eboekhouden_create_product, eboekhouden_create_invoice · Destructive: eboekhouden_create_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
